items.reason: Both describe global VIEW short-circuiting client-specific denials, allowing denied clients to be read and listed.
Both describe getClientsWithPermission enumerating the type-level Clients resource instead of actual client IDs, causing incorrect results or null client dereferences.
Both identify the missing global MANAGE grant in ClientPermissionsV2.canView(). Including that grant fixes the shared predicate defect, although this comment describes a different consequence.
